items.title: Elon Musk splits with longtime business confidante, co-parent ‘with no warning’
items.description: Shivon Zilis, the mother of four children with Musk, said their breakup was sudden but wished him the best.

items.title: Trump expected to name intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
items.description: The appointment comes after the White House this week hosted tech executives for a summit on artificial intelligence.

items.title: How to tell your career story when you are bouncing from job to job
items.description: It can be hard for people to establish themselves in the gig economy since it can mean having to prove themselves to each new boss and client.
